LoadAudioAdvanced.description:
Load an audio file and output AUDIO.
• Audio file: pick from ComfyUI's `input` directory, or use the upload button to bring in a file from anywhere on this machine. The audio is previewed as soon as you pick it, without running the node.
• Video files (mp4 / mkv / mov / avi / webm / flv / ts…) are accepted and the audio is extracted automatically
• Truncation: take a segment from the start, any middle range, or from a point to the end

音频文件.name: Audio file
音频文件.tooltip: Pick a file from the ComfyUI `input` directory, or use the upload button to bring in a file from anywhere on this machine. The player below previews it immediately.

音轨序号.name: Audio track index
音轨序号.tooltip: Which audio track to use for files with multiple tracks (e.g. videos). 0 means the first track.

截断方式.name: Truncation mode
截断方式.tooltip:
How to cut a long audio file:
① Head segment only: from 0 s, take Duration to take seconds
② Middle range only: from Start to End
③ From start to the end: use everything from Start to the end of the file
For ① fill in Duration to take; for ② fill in Start and End; for ③ fill in Start only.

起点(秒).name: Start (seconds)
起点(秒).tooltip:
Where to start (seconds).
Middle range: used together with End.
From start to the end: the starting position; End is ignored.

终点(秒).name: End (seconds)
终点(秒).tooltip:
Where to stop (seconds). Must be greater than Start.
Only applies to the Middle range mode; ignored in other modes.

截取时长(秒).name: Duration to take (seconds)
截取时长(秒).tooltip:
How much to take (seconds), measured from the beginning of the file, so the start is fixed at 0 s.
Only applies to the Head segment mode; ignored in other modes.

报告语言.name: Report language
报告语言.tooltip:
Language of this node's report text.
With "Follow UI language" the report is Chinese while the ComfyUI interface is Chinese, and English otherwise.

SaveAudioPlatformExport.description:
Export AUDIO to WAV / MP3 / FLAC / OPUS in one run, with a platform compliance report.
• Sample rate / channels / WAV bit depth / MP3 bitrate / OPUS bitrate set to "Auto" follow the source audio parameters
• Directly connected to "Load Audio (Advanced)" for format conversion: when the target format matches the source and all parameters are "Auto", the source file is copied as-is (instant, no re-encoding)
• Multiple target formats can be produced in a single run
• The player below previews the exported file after the node runs

音频.name: Audio
音频.tooltip: The AUDIO input of any audio output node.

文件名前缀.name: Filename prefix
文件名前缀.tooltip: A relative path inside the ComfyUI output directory. Absolute paths are rejected.

WAV位深.name: WAV bit depth
WAV位深.tooltip: WAV sample bit depth. "Auto" follows the source bit depth (16-bit if unknown).

MP3码率.name: MP3 bitrate
MP3码率.tooltip: MP3 bitrate. "Auto" uses 320 kbps for lossless sources and never exceeds a lossy source's bitrate; "V0" is variable-bitrate highest quality.

OPUS码率.name: OPUS bitrate
OPUS码率.tooltip: OPUS bitrate. "Auto" uses 192 kbps for lossless sources and never exceeds a lossy source's bitrate.

采样率.name: Sample rate
采样率.tooltip: Sample rate. "Auto" follows the source sample rate.

声道.name: Channels
声道.tooltip: Channel count. "Auto" follows the source channel count.

平台预设.name: Platform preset
平台预设.tooltip: Fills the fields below with the requirements of the selected platform. "Custom" and "No validation" leave them to you.

平台名称.name: Platform name
平台名称.tooltip: Shown in the compliance report. Filled in automatically when a preset is selected.

最低采样率.name: Minimum sample rate
最低采样率.tooltip: Minimum sample rate required by the platform (Hz).

最低位深.name: Minimum bit depth
最低位深.tooltip: Minimum bit depth required by the platform (bit); applies to WAV only.

最低码率kbps.name: Minimum bitrate (kbps)
最低码率kbps.tooltip: Minimum bitrate required by the platform (kbps); applies to MP3 / OPUS only.

要求声道.name: Required channels
要求声道.tooltip: Channel count required by the platform.

文件大小上限MB.name: Max file size (MB)
文件大小上限MB.tooltip: Maximum size of a single audio file (MB). Anything larger is treated as non-compliant.

报告语言.name: Report language
报告语言.tooltip:
Language of the compliance report.
With "Follow UI language" the report is Chinese while the ComfyUI interface is Chinese, and English otherwise.

LoadVideoAdvanced.description:
Load a video file and output VIDEO.
• Video file: pick from ComfyUI's `input` directory. To use a local file, drag and drop it into the input directory first; the video is previewed as soon as you pick it, without running the node
• Supports mp4 / mkv / mov / avi / webm / flv / ts and other mainstream formats
• Truncation: take a segment from the start, any middle range, or from a point to the end

视频文件.name: Video file
视频文件.tooltip: Pick a video from the ComfyUI `input` directory, or use the upload button to bring in a file from anywhere on this machine. The player below previews it immediately.

视频流序号.name: Video stream index
视频流序号.tooltip: Which video stream to use for files with multiple streams. 0 means the first one.

截断方式.name: Truncation mode
截断方式.tooltip:
How to cut a long video:
① Head segment only: from 0 s, take Duration to take seconds
② Middle range only: from Start to End
③ From start to the end: use everything from Start to the end of the video
For ① fill in Duration to take; for ② fill in Start and End; for ③ fill in Start only.

起点(秒).name: Start (seconds)
起点(秒).tooltip:
Where to start (seconds).
Middle range: used together with End.
From start to the end: the starting position; End is ignored.

终点(秒).name: End (seconds)
终点(秒).tooltip:
Where to stop (seconds). Must be greater than Start.
Only applies to the Middle range mode; ignored in other modes.

截取时长(秒).name: Duration to take (seconds)
截取时长(秒).tooltip:
How much to take (seconds), measured from the beginning of the file, so the start is fixed at 0 s.
Only applies to the Head segment mode; ignored in other modes.

报告语言.name: Report language
报告语言.tooltip:
Language of this node's report text.

SaveVideoConverter.description:
Export VIDEO to MP4 / MKV / WEBM / AVI / MOV in one run.
• Resolution / frame rate / video codec / audio handling set to "Auto" follow the source video
• Directly connected to "Load Video (Advanced)" for format conversion: when the target format matches the source and all parameters are "Auto", the source file is copied as-is (instant, no re-encoding)
• Multiple target formats can be produced in a single run; no report is produced, files are simply written to disk
• The player below previews the exported file after the node runs

视频.name: Video
视频.tooltip: The VIDEO input of any video output node.

文件名前缀.name: Filename prefix
文件名前缀.tooltip: A relative path inside the ComfyUI output directory. Absolute paths are rejected.

视频编码.name: Video codec
视频编码.tooltip: "Auto" reuses the source codec; if that codec is incompatible with the target container it falls back to the container's recommended codec.

画质CRF.name: Quality CRF
画质CRF.tooltip: Constant rate factor. Lower values mean higher quality and larger files; "Auto" picks a sensible default per codec.

分辨率.name: Resolution
分辨率.tooltip: "Keep original" uses the source resolution; any other option scales to the listed size proportionally (no distortion, no cropping).

帧率.name: Frame rate
帧率.tooltip: "Keep original" uses the source frame rate; any other option outputs the given value.

音频处理.name: Audio handling
音频处理.tooltip: "Keep original audio" does not re-encode; "Auto" transcodes when the target container cannot carry the source audio; "Remove audio" exports a silent video; any other option forces transcoding to that format.

音频码率.name: Audio bitrate
音频码率.tooltip: Bitrate used when the audio is re-encoded. "Auto" picks a common value for the chosen audio codec.

报告语言.name: Report language
报告语言.tooltip:
Language of the parameter report.
With "Follow UI language" the report is Chinese while the ComfyUI interface is Chinese, and English otherwise.

VideoReportNode.description:
Report the parameters of the source video and of every exported file.
• Reads the real values back from disk with ffprobe-free PyAV probing
• Shows resolution / frame rate / codecs / duration / size / audio track
• Works for a converted file as well as for a same-format copy

视频.name: Video
视频.tooltip: The VIDEO input of any video output node.

报告语言.name: Report language
报告语言.tooltip:
Language of the report text.
With "Follow UI language" the report is Chinese while the ComfyUI interface is Chinese, and English otherwise.
